location_description: Queensbury is a town in Warren County, New York, United States. The population was 27,901 at the 2010 census.It contains the county seat of Warren County, located at a municipal center complex on U.S. Route 9 south of the village of Lake George. It was moved to the complex in 1963 from the original county seat of Lake George.
